title: Byte-exact CBOR vector
description: Engineering consequence of QR Code Generation, 12.5 Size at each stage; DVC QR example, machine-readable summary (test participant XXA).

statements.label: Byte-exact CBOR vector
statements.requirement: Encoding the PR 129 example claim sets with deterministic CBOR SHALL give exactly the payload bytes inside the committed COSE_Sign1: 210 bytes for hepb1 and 209 for bcg. Signed, deflated and HC1 sizes SHALL NOT be asserted exactly, because signatures are randomized.
